heading: 4.1.1 Storage types
text:
#### 4.1.1 Storage types [LUNI.4.1.1]

v1 admits three storage types:

| Storage | Width | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `int32` | 4 B inline | Small counted quantities (rare for `unit dimension`; more common via `unit scalar`) |
| `int64` | 8 B inline | The default integer storage — time (nanoseconds), currency (cents / minor units), counted quantities |
| `float64` | 8 B inline | IEEE 754 binary64 — physical quantities (length, mass, temperature, …) |
